result.instructions: Tools for Routific, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Plan one van for these five stops, starting and ending at our depot, with an 8:00 to 16:00 shift."; "Plan tomorrow's pickups and deliveries for our three couriers."; "Check whether route job 5f3c2a is finished and show the stop order.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Routific data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run routific_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run routific_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run routific_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. routific_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: routific_optimize_routes
tools.title: Optimize routes
tools.description: Plan the fastest routes for a fleet that serves a set of stops, with time windows and capacity. Synchronous; times out after about 20 seconds, so use routific_submit_route_job above 60 visits. Routific API: POST /v1/vrp.

name.description: Address or place name. Routific geocodes it when lat and lng are not set.

lat.description: Latitude. Set with lng to skip geocoding.

lng.description: Longitude. Set with lat to skip geocoding.

location.description: A location: an address name, or coordinates.

duration.description: Time spent at the stop, in minutes.

load.description: Load added (positive) or removed (negative) at the stop.

additionalProperties.description: One stop with its time window, service time and load.

visits.description: Map of visit ID to stop. The IDs are yours; the routes refer to them.

tools.name: routific_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Read a background route job by job_id. Status is pending, processing, finished or error; a finished job's route plan is in output. Routific API: GET /jobs/{id}.

jobId.description: Job ID from routific_submit_route_job or routific_submit_pickups_deliveries_job.
